title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Logistik- / Lagerplanung
description:
Du willst Logistik nicht nur planen, sondern aktiv mitgestalten?

Du hast in der Logistikberatung schon einiges bewegt und willst bei deinem nächsten Schritt nicht bei der Konzeptfolie aufhören, sondern Projekte bis zur Inbetriebnahme begleiten. Als Senior Consultant übernimmst du bei ebp-consulting Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Lagerplanungsprojekte, von der ersten Datenanalyse über das Grobkonzept bis zum fertigen Lager, und das nie allein: Projekte laufen bei ebp-consulting immer im Team.

ebp-consulting ist eine unabhängige Logistikberatung mit Wurzeln in der Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft. Für den Standort Stuttgart oder Dortmund wird jetzt Verstärkung gesucht, weil die Nachfrage nach Lagerplanungsprojekten weiter wächst. Mehr zum Unternehmen weiter unten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die eigenständige Bearbeitung und Leitung von Lagerplanungsprojekten, von der Analyse über Grob- und Detailplanung bis zur Umsetzungsbegleitung und Inbetriebnahme
  • Du analysierst Material- und Warenströme, wertest Mengengerüste aus und leitest daraus Layouts und Lagertechnikkonzepte ab
  • Du wählst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden die passende Lagertechnik aus, holst Angebote ein und koordinierst die Gewerke bis zum Hochlauf
  • Du bringst dich fachlich bei der Projektakquisition ein und pflegst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, wenn dir das liegt (kein Muss, aber willkommen)
  • Du gibst dein Know-how nach der Einarbeitung an jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter, zum Beispiel als Pate im Projekt
  • Du bringst eigene fachliche Themen voran, etwa Robotics oder Datenanalyse, wenn dich das Feld reizt

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, zum Beispiel Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Schwerpunkt Logistik oder Supply Chain Management
  • 5 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in der Beratung, extern oder in der Inhouse-Beratung eines Industrieunternehmens
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Lagerplanung und -technik über mehrere abgeschlossene Projekte hinweg, idealerweise branchenübergreifend
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenanalyse und Routine im Umgang mit MS Excel
  • Du denkst konzeptionell, entwickelst Alternativen, vergleichst sie und triffst begründete Entscheidungen
  • Projektmanagement-Erfahrung, ohne dass dir dabei die fachliche Tiefe verloren geht
  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau (verhandlungssicher)
  • Reisebereitschaft für Projekte beim Kunden, rund 80 % im deutschsprachigen Raum (DACH), der Rest projektabhängig im europäischen Ausland

Wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung aus einer anderen Logistikberatung
  • CAD-Kenntnisse
  • Erste Erfahrung mit AMR/AGV
  • Englisch auf B2-Niveau
  • Lust, dich langfristig in Richtung Managing Consultant zu entwickeln

Benefits

  • Festanstellung in einem Beratungshaus mit gefüllten Auftragsbüchern und seit über 20 Jahren durchgehend positivem Jahresergebnis
  • Bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge, gestaffelt nach Betriebszugehörigkeit, sowie eine vom Unternehmen getragene private Unfallversicherung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeit mit Kernarbeitszeit zwischen 10 und 16 Uhr, keine Arbeitszeiterfassung nach Stechuhr
  • Präsenz im Büro als gelebte Teamkultur, Home-Office ist projektbezogen möglich oder bei längerem Arbeitsweg
  • Dein Travel Management bucht Zug, Flug oder Mietwagen für dich, um die Organisation kümmerst du dich nicht selbst
  • Individuelle Weiterbildung im Rahmen der jährlichen Zielvereinbarung, intern und extern, unter anderem über die Haufe Akademie
  • Bike-Leasing zu Firmenkonditionen und Corporate Benefits mit Rabatten bei Partnern wie Adidas sowie bei Reisen und Auto
  • 30 Tage Urlaub im Kalenderjahr
  • Klarer Entwicklungspfad zum Managing Consultant mit wachsender Projekt-, Team- und Kundenverantwortung
  • Keine Konzernstrukturen
  • Team-Events mit Substanz statt Pflichtprogramm, von mehrtägigen Trips wie Skifahren oder Mallorca über Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier bis zu Afterworks wie Bowling oder Escape Room und spontanem Grillen auf der Terrasse

Über ebp-consulting

Rund 50 Mitarbeitende arbeiten von den Standorten Stuttgart (Firmensitz), München, Dortmund und einem Standort in Südafrika aus an anspruchsvollen Beratungs- und Planungsprojekten für eine branchenübergreifende Kundschaft, von renommierten Mittelständlern bis zu internationalen Konzernen aus Branchen wie Automotive, Medizintechnik, Konsumgüter und Maschinenbau. Konkrete Referenzen finden sich auf der Website von ebp-consulting.

ebp-consulting verbindet fachliche Beratung mit Umsetzung, Konzepte werden nicht nur entworfen, sondern auch umgesetzt und in Betrieb genommen, im eigenen Team und mit Partnern wie Architekten oder Anlagenbauern. Geführt wird das Unternehmen von den Gründern Dr.-Ing. Jochen Braun und Dipl.-Ing. Frank Gehr gemeinsam mit zwei Managing Partnern.

Verstanden wird sich als familiäres Team mit lockerem Umgang, das in der Sache professionell bleibt und keine Ellenbogenmentalität kennt. Wer hier arbeitet, schätzt kurze Wege, direkte Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, auch standortübergreifend.

Häufige Fragen zur Position

Wie läuft das Onboarding ab? Du wächst je nach Erfahrung in dein Themenfeld hinein, mit internen Schulungen bei Bedarf und eng begleitet durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Projekt.

Wie sieht die Weiterentwicklung aus? Ab rund 8 Jahren Erfahrung und mehreren erfolgreich geleiteten Großprojekten wird der nächste Schritt die Position als Managing Consultant, mit eigener Team-, Projekt- und Kundenverantwortung.

Wie ist die Vergütung strukturiert? Fixgehalt plus leistungsbezogener variabler Anteil, der sich an deinen fakturierten Projekttagen orientiert. Die konkrete Spanne besprechen wir gerne persönlich im Kennenlerngespräch.

Wie läuft der Bewerbungsprozess ab? Auf ein erstes Kennenlernen folgt ein persönliches Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem künftigen Team vor Ort.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ein aktueller Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben ist kein Muss. Bei Fragen vorab meldest du dich einfach bei uns unter -----

title: Senior Incident Responder (m/w/d)
description:

Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology"

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

Senior Incident Responder (m/w/d)

Aufgaben

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Incident Response: Du betreust komplexe Cyber Security Incidents bei unseren Kunden und begleitest die First Response, Analyse, Eindämmung, Aufarbeitung und Wiederherstellung
  • Incident-Leitung: Du steuerst Sicherheitsvorfälle, koordinierst alle beteiligten Parteien und sorgst für eine strukturierte, zielorientierte und verlässliche Bearbeitung. Dabei bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen den technischen Workstreams und der Entscheider-Ebene, beispielsweise dem Krisenstab oder dem Management. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen Ansprechpartnern sowie dem Management und steuerst das Incident Response Team
  • Security Consulting: Du berätst unsere Kunden vor und nach Sicherheitsvorfällen ganzheitlich, um die Strategie, die technische Architektur, Prozesse und Skills des Cyber Defense Centers weiterzuentwickeln
  • Threat Landscape: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team behältst Du die aktuelle Bedrohungslage im Blick. Du informierst unsere Kunden auf technischer und Management-Ebene über relevante Bedrohungen und gibst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Technische Schulungen: Du konzipierst und hältst Schulungen, Workshops, Trainings und Übungen rund um Incident Response, Digitaler Forensik und CDC
  • Service Management: Du verantwortest die Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Incident-Response-Services und setzt neue Ideen konsequent um
  • Konzepte und Prozesse: Du entwickelst unsere Incident-Response-Konzepte, Prozesse und Standards kontinuierlich weiter und etablierst praxistaugliche Strukturen

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Führungserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Führungserfahrung mit und hast bereits ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geleitet
  • Incident Response: Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Koordination komplexer Cyber Security Incidents
  • Threat Landscape: Du kennst die aktuelle Bedrohungslage und verstehst relevante Threat Actors, Angreifertechniken und Angriffsmuster, beispielsweise bei APT-Angriffen, Ransomware, Innentätern oder Supply-Chain-Angriffen
  • Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Security-Technologien wie SIEM, EDR und NDR
  • Consulting-Erfahrung: Du bist mit der Beratung von Kunden vertraut und vermittelst technische Sachverhalte klar und adressatengerecht und agierst sicher als Schnittstelle zwischen technischen Workstreams, Krisenstab und Management
  • Schulungserfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung technischer Schulungen, Workshops oder Übungen
  • Prozesse und Services: Du hast Security-Incident-Management-Prozesse, fachliche Konzepte oder Cyber Security Services entwickelt und erfolgreich weitergeführt
  • KI und Innovation: Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von KI oder Large Language Models in DFIR-Services oder vergleichbare Tätigkeiten
  • Service Management: Du weißt, wie professionelle Cyber Security Services gesteuert, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden. Ebenfalls hast Du bereits die potentiale von KI/LLM erkannt und hast diese in Cyber Security Services oder Tätigkeiten integriert
  • Führungspersönlichkeit: Du führst klar und verbindlich, kannst Menschen motivieren und gehst empathisch auf unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten ein
  • Gestaltungswille: Du bringst neue Ideen und strategischen Weitblick ein, übernimmst Verantwortung und setzt Veränderungen konsequent um
  • Qualifikation: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und rund 20 Prozent Reisebereitschaft (DACH-Raum)

Benefits

Was dich aber vor allem erwartet:

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. title: Tech Lead (f/d/m)
description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.
  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.
  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.
  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.
  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.
  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.
  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.
  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.
  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.

Benefits

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team
  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe
  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

As always in early stage startups, your role will include adjacent tasks, e.g., PR, social media or branding. What you’ll bring:

  • Strong system architecture and design skills, with thorough understanding of SOLID principles, TDD, DDD, and software design patterns.

  • Experience designing for resilience and performance at scale (graceful degradation, zero-downtime deployments, observability, performance budgets).

  • Experience with Azure development and cloud-based infrastructure, including CI/CD and pipeline observability.

  • Experience owning threat modelling and security hardening for front-end products; strong grasp of OWASP and secure coding practices.

  • Track record of originating and shepherding cross-team initiatives or RFCs to adoption.

  • Excellent coaching, mentoring, and leadership skills - with evidence of being a force multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and strategic thinking.

  • Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Comfortable representing Flagstone externally (talks, writing, community engagement) - or keen to start.

  • Agile and Scrum practices experience.

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

title: Regional Operator Education Specialist
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As Regional Operator Education Specialist you are responsible for the quality and delivery of onboarding for clinical operators across your region, ensuring training maintains a consistently high standard. You support and quality-assure the work carried out by Clinic Trainers, and act as the escalation point for clinical training matters, so that methods, delivery, and assessments stay aligned with global standards.

You also contribute to the maintenance of training programs and content, adapting them for local market needs based on central guidelines and frameworks. This is a competency-based training and safety function.

A note on this role

Medical Education at Neko is growing and its structure is still developing. This is an interim appointment, and the scope described here may change as the wider function takes shape. We will be open with you about any changes as they happen.

What You'll Deliver

Onboarding quality and escalation

  • Ensure clinical operator onboarding is delivered to a high and consistent standard across your region, aligned with central guidelines and member safety requirements.

  • Run the onboarding cycle: confirm incoming starters with Recruitment, allocate trainers, and monitor daily trainee progress, stepping in early where progression is slow.

  • Hold the decision to pass, extend, or offboard a trainee in your region, alongside the Lead Operator team.

  • Act as the regional escalation point for clinical training quality and safety matters, triaging every case on first pass to distinguish a genuine safety risk from a standard performance gap, and seeing it through to closure including structured improvement plans.

Support and coach Clinic Trainers

  • Provide guidance, feedback, and support to Clinic Trainers on training methodology, delivery, and assessment.

  • Hold trainers in your region to one national standard, working with Lead Operators so operational needs are met at the same time.

  • Follow up on trainer performance and development.

  • Support Clinic Trainers in completing Impact Reviews for existing clinical staff in line with Neko’s pillars.

Maintain and adapt training programs

  • Maintain training programs and materials as requested, including Sana content, and adapt them to local market needs while staying aligned with global standards and following approval guidelines.

  • Work from one shared source with your counterpart region rather than maintaining separate regional versions, and flag content gaps and inconsistencies centrally rather than resolving them locally in isolation.

  • Deliver or coordinate key clinical skills training within your region, for example Gen II retrofit training, and provide training-plan input into clinic launches and retrofits.

Monitor training quality and drive improvement

  • Observe training delivery, provide structured feedback, and follow up on what changes as a result.

  • Run regional training audits and benchmarks against the national standard, identifying gaps and putting forward improvement proposals, including corrective action where an audit finding requires it.

  • Oversee trainers’ records of staff competency sign-off. No operator works unsupervised on a new device until sign-off is confirmed.

  • Feed hiring and training trends back to Recruitment so screening improves from what is seen downstream in training.

Partner across the business

  • Work closely with clinic leadership and relevant support functions so training meets operational needs as well as the clinical standard, and act as a regional training voice with Recruitment, clinic leads, and cluster management, syncing regularly to stay aligned nationally.

  • Work closely with Clinical Development, participating in product launch handovers and acting as the educational link for your region, including developing training materials for new devices and SOPs when requested and supporting rollout to trainers and operators on the ground.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Healthcare professional with at least two years of clinical experience.

  • Significant post-registration experience in a fast-paced, high-volume clinical setting.

  • Demonstrated clinical leadership, formal or informal.

  • Existing trainer or competency sign-off experience within a Neko clinic, or equivalent clinical procedure competency such as phlebotomy or ECG.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing clinical teams or trainers, including performance management across multiple sites.

  • Track record in competency-based training and assessment.

  • Experience developing or scaling training frameworks to support clinic expansion.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Recruitment, Operations, or Education teams.

  • A postgraduate certification in a specialist clinical area or in leadership.

Key competencies

  • Strong communication and a coaching mindset

  • Sound clinical judgement under ambiguity

  • A collaborative approach with operators, clinic leads, and trainers

  • Adaptability to new processes and policies

  • Attention to detail in competency checks and training materials

  • Organisational skills across multiple concurrent onboarding cycles

  • A proactive, problem-solving approach to gaps in knowledge or process

Working conditions

  • This role carries protected training capacity on a fixed weekly structure, with a minimum of one scanning day so you remain clinically current and credible with the operators you train.

  • A minimum trial or shadow period applies before full sign-off authority is confirmed, given the clinical safety responsibilities of the role.

  • This is a hands-on regional role with regular travel across your clinic cluster.

title: Engagement Director - Strategic Accounts
description:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Director to join our growing team and lead Legora's most strategic accounts ( large global law firms and strategic enterprises) as they fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside the world's largest, most complex organizations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of a focused set of marquee accounts: building C-suite and executive-sponsor relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted advisor and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how the world's most sophisticated legal teams operate.

At the heart of the role is designing each client's adoption playbook and delivering multi-year change-management programs that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, oftentimes across a multinational footprint, define measurable outcomes and ROI, and evolve the program as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

People management experience is a bonus as you will lead a small team of Engagement Managers and Associates who are dedicated to the success of your clients. In return, you are dedicated to the development of your team.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, setting the bar on our most visible accounts and helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases, and transform the way their teams work.

What You’ll Do

You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realization for a focused portfolio of Legora's most strategic accounts — Specifically, you will:

  • Design each client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map, and target outcomes for how that organization adopts Legora and transforms the way it works — across practice groups, business units and regions.

  • Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to firm-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.

  • Act as a senior strategic advisor who deeply understands client goals and legal workflows, owns C-suite and executive relationships, surfaces high-impact opportunities, and guides teams toward maximum value from Legora.

  • Lead a small team (consisting of Engagement Managers and Associates) dedicated to your accounts and take responsibility for their development.

  • Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and executive-level value reviews.

  • Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Technical Operations, GTM, Marketing), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination across every region and workstream.

  • Partner with GTM leadership on the most complex commercial moments — high-stakes renewals and multi-year expansions — to ensure seamless handoffs, continuity, and a great customer experience, and to identify and realize expansion opportunities.

  • Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Legal Engineering to shape roadmap, positioning, and enablement for Legora's most strategic segment.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering the most demanding executive stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason the world's most sophisticated legal organizations adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:

  • A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programs inside the world's largest, most complex organizations — Fortune 100, AmLaw 50, or globally strategic enterprises.

title: Head of Product
description:
About Us 

We are passionate industry experts in the property risk, compliance and safety management industry providing our leading end-to-end solution QUOODA – A platform for property owners and managers to maintain and manage a single source of truth for their complete property portfolio, covering commercial, residential, education, health, financial, tech, and telecoms sectors. 

Our platform is used by over 8000 users across trusted industry leaders and is responsible for managing several of the UK's most iconic buildings, such as London's O2 Arena, The Shard, One Blackfriars, and The Cheese Grater to name just a few. 

The goal of QUOODA is to make it quicker and easier to manage property risk and compliance, providing key information at your fingertips in real-time covering Health & Safety, Fire Safety, Environmental impact, Asset Management, Work Permits and more. 

 

The Team 

Our team is focused on delivering an industry leading platform for our users and providing them with the right features to simplify their tasks. To do this, the team is fully cross-functional and follows agile best practices in a highly collaborative environment - Taking ownership of the platform architecture, infrastructure, and application lifecycle following the 'Build It, Ship It, Own It' philosophy.  

We currently have several teams made up of engineers, testers, and product owners, and are expanding these as we move closer to our scalability and growth targets. This is an exciting time to join our team, as there are great opportunities to make your mark and influence how we do things as we progress with our expansion. 

 

The Role 

As Head of Product, you are the voice, validator and external face of QUOODA. Engineering owns what gets built and why; you bring the customer and commercial judgement they need to make those decisions well, and you are accountable for ensuring the product meets the bar before it reaches customers. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the CTO and Director of Engineering: you keep them unblocked, informed and well-connected to the commercial and customer context they need. You are the product's spokesperson externally to customers, to sales and new business, and to customer success and you facilitate a direct, unfiltered relationship between engineering and the wider business. You do not sit in the middle: you remove friction, surface context, and validate outcomes. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

 

Product direction and voice 

  • Set and communicate product strategy. Curate and communicate the QUOODA v2 roadmap, reflecting engineering decisions and ensuring the rationale is clearly articulated to the business and market. 
  • Be the spokesperson for QUOODA. Represent the product internally and externally through demos, briefings, webinars, customer councils, sales conversations and analyst or prospect engagements. 
  • Work closely with the CTO and Director of Engineering. Be their primary point of contact for commercial and customer context. Keep them informed of business priorities, market signals and customer feedback so they can make well-grounded decisions without being pulled into business-facing meetings themselves. Flag blockers, misalignments and communication gaps early. 
  • Facilitate prioritisation. Facilitate prioritisation conversations between engineering, commercial and customers. Bring domain and customer context to those decisions, and ensure engineering has what it needs to make well-informed calls. 

Commercial, customer success and sales partnership 

  • Enable sales and new business. Equip the commercial team with messaging, positioning, demo narratives and answers to the hard questions, so they can win against incumbents and triple our customer base by 2030. 
  • Partner with customer success. Translate adoption signals, support themes and renewal risk into product decisions, and give CS the roadmap clarity they need to retain and grow accounts. 

The v1-to-v2 migration 

  • Support engineering in leading the migration of 70 customers from QUOODA v1 to v2. Own the customer-facing communication and experience of the migration. Be the named, accountable point of contact for customers throughout the transition, ensuring engineering has the business and customer context needed to sequence and execute it well. 
  • Surface migration risk to engineering. Ensure engineering has unfiltered customer insight to inform their parity decisions. Own the customer-facing communication of each change — what is different, why, and what support is available, once engineering has made those calls. 
  • Lead the UAT process for QUOODA v2. Be the primary voice from the customer and business perspective on whether the product is ready. Sign off that it meets the bar commercially and functionally in partnership with engineering who hold the technical quality bar. The go/no-go decision is a shared call, and it is explicit. 
  • Curate the backlog of known issues. Turn five years of accumulated, hard-won knowledge about v1's gaps into clear intent for v2. 

Working in an AI-native SDLC 

  • Surface context, not tickets. Surface customer problems, commercial outcomes and real-world constraints in a form that is immediately useful to engineers and AI agents. The goal is to enrich engineering's intent, not to originate it. 
  • Represent the product-engineering model externally. Help customers, partners and the wider business understand how our product-engineering model works and why it produces better outcomes. Engineering owns the operating model itself; your role is to make it legible and credible to the outside world. 

 

Requirements  

 

Essential 

  • Demonstrable product leadership experience in B2B / enterprise SaaS, ideally with a complex, configurable platform. 
  • A credible, confident external presence, comfortable being the face of a product with customers, prospects, sales and CS. 
  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how product decisions drive pipeline, win rates, retention and growth. 
  • Experience owning a major product transition, migration or re-platforming with a live customer base. 
  • Fluency with (or genuine enthusiasm to embrace) an AI-native, agentic software development lifecycle: working alongside AI coding agents, expressing intent rather than writing exhaustive specs, and evaluating AI-built software. 

 

Highly desirable 

  • Regulated domain experience, ideally in GRC, risk, compliance, audit, or adjacent regulated enterprise software. 
  • Familiarity with API-first, cloud-native product architectures. 
  • Hands-on comfort with AI tooling: prototyping, prompting, and defining evaluations to assess output quality. 
  • Experience in a private-equity backed or high-growth scale-up environment. 

 

Benefits 

  • Competitive salary (depending on experience). 
  • 25 days annual leave (excluding UK bank holidays). 
  • 5% Matched company pension. 
  • Vitality private health insurance (includes Vitality membership). 
  • 4x salary life cover. 
  • Perk Pal retail discounts. 
  • Regular virtual and in-person social events. 

 

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for writing high-scale, secure, cloud native software, this is an exciting opportunity to grow and help shape the future of our product, platform, and culture.  

 

Sustainware is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine — acquisition, retention, propensity modelling, and customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Staff Full Stack Data Analyst, you are the senior technical voice for commercial analytics at Pleo. You set the architectural direction for Growth Intelligence's analytics layer, define what good looks like for the team, and shape how GTM data is structured, governed, and consumed by people and increasingly by AI tools.

You bring technical depth, commercial instinct, and organisational reach in equal measure. You move between architecture reviews and executive presentations, between defining metric contracts and mentoring the analysts who implement them. You don't just answer questions - you identify the right ones, and you make sure the answers compound over time.

Who you'll work with

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner closely with senior commercial leadership, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams; the onboarding and self-serve product teams; Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers across the broader data organization; and Data Services & Governance on standards and semantic layer ownership. You will be a visible, senior presence across the entire data community at Pleo.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the architectural direction of the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention. You'll be making systemic decisions about how models are structured, layered, and governed, not just what gets built next.

  • Identify and resolve upstream data quality issues at source, treating quality gaps as governance and contract problems, articulating the business risk they create, and driving the org-level changes needed to fix them durably.

  • Define canonical GTM metric definitions in the semantic layer, in partnership with Data Services & Governance while ensuring RevOps, CS, CX, BI tools, and AI tooling are working from the same source of truth, and holding that standard over time.

  • Partner with senior commercial leadership to shape the questions worth answering.

  • Lead in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns.

  • Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result.

  • Build analytics explicitly architected for self-serve and AI access: structured, documented, and reliable enough for business teams, conversational analytics tools, and AI features to consume autonomously.

  • Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft.

  • Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo.

For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

What you bring

  • Prior experience operating at Staff or Lead level in data analytics or analytics engineering roles in a fast-paced SaaS organisation.

  • Expert knowledge of SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested, well-architected models and can make and defend layering decisions for a team, not just yourself.

  • Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation.

  • Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.

  • BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale.

  • Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni.

  • Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level.

  • Systems thinking on data quality: you approach quality gaps as governance questions, identify root causes upstream, and drive fixes that last rather than patches that don't.

  • Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick.

  • Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and you know why metric consistency becomes critical as AI tooling scales.

  • Track record of advising senior GTM stakeholders around shaping the question as much as answering it, and communicating risk and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.

  • Experience mentoring analysts and raising team capability

Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You excel at turning large, interconnected and complex problems into well structured, clearly defined and pragmatic solutions. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity within a fast-paced SaaS organisation, and can generate clarity, you'll find this role very exciting.

  • You find hands-on technical work as exciting as stakeholders management, delivery management and governance strategy.

  • You have operated as a Technical Lead for Commercial / Growth Analytics within a 500+ people SaaS organisation and understand the recurring topics, challenges and goals businesses of our scale experience.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Risk & Controls Officer to join our Risk & Control team at Pleo. In this role, you'll operate as a key part of our Second Line of Defence, helping to strengthen the risk management framework that underpins everything we do — from our product to our regulatory relationships. You'll work at the intersection of risk expertise and business partnership, offering thoughtful challenges and practical guidance to our First Line teams as we continue to scale. If you're excited by the prospect of shaping how a fast-growing FinTech approaches risk maturity, and are passionate about building robust, pragmatic control environments, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Head of Risk and Control and work closely with First Line teams across the business. Our Risk & Control team is highly collaborative and dedicated to driving a culture of sound risk management across Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Operations, Finance, and Compliance to ensure cross-functional success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Risk & Controls Officer, you will:

  • Support Risk Framework Execution – Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of Pleo's 2LOD risk management framework, ensuring controls remain aligned with regulatory expectations and business strategy.

  • Execute Oversight Activities – Conduct RCSAs (Risk and Control Self Assessments) and control reviews across the business. Assess the quality of risk identification and control design, and challenge 1LOD findings where appropriate.

  • Identify & Assess Risks – Support scenario analysis and stress-testing exercises across operational, technology, product, and credit risk domains. Help surface emerging risk exposures to leadership.

  • Be a Reliable Risk Advisor – Support business teams with guidance on risk topics, control requirements, and regulatory change, providing practical recommendations on risk and control issues.

  • Support Risk Reporting & Regulatory Engagement – Contribute to the preparation of clear, data-informed risk reports for senior management and governance committees, and assist with regulator interactions on risk and control matters.

To put things into context, we currently have scaling our 2LOD oversight framework and enhancing cross-functional RCSA processes on our roadmap. You can expect to work with modern risk management platforms, GRC tools, and data analytics dashboards.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Financial Services Experience – 3+ years of experience in a regulated financial services environment (FinTech, banking, payments, or similar) with hands-on experience in risk or control management.

  • Essential Credit Risk Expertise – A solid, demonstrated understanding of the assessment and management of credit risk.

  • Core Risk Domain Knowledge – Proven experience with operational risk, technology risk, and product risk assessment.

  • Hands-On Risk & Control Execution – Background in ERM framework execution, control design, RCSAs, assurance activities, and remediation tracking.

  • Clear & Collaborative Communication – Ability to translate complex risk concepts into practical, accessible language for diverse audiences, from frontline teams to leadership.

  • Pragmatic, Solutions-Oriented Approach – A real-world problem-solving mindset that delivers workable answers to real risk challenges rather than defaulting to theoretical frameworks alone.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to actively shape 2LOD risk maturity in a high-growth FinTech scale-up.

  • You enjoy a pragmatic, hands-on role where risk oversight directly enables business growth and innovation.

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment partnering with cross-functional teams across Product, Operations, and Finance.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • Your background is primarily in traditional Internal Audit, Consulting, or pure Compliance without direct operational risk framework and RCSA experience.

  • You prefer operating strictly within rigid, theoretical risk models without adapting to fast-paced commercial realities.

  • You prefer purely administrative risk logging over proactive challenge, advisory, and stakeholder collaboration.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Get under the skin of Pleo's risk landscape and take ownership of key 2LOD review, RCSA, and challenge activities across priority business areas.

  • Play an active role in evolving our risk framework as the company continues to scale — contributing your expertise to initiatives that shape how we manage risk for years to come.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships, establishing yourself as a credible, trusted advisor on risk and control matters.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means deepening your technical subject matter expertise, expanding your regulatory exposure, or stepping into broader leadership responsibilities within the Risk team.

The interview process

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

title: Chef de projet - Grands comptes cabinets comptables F/H
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu aimes trouver du sens dans ton travail et travailler sur une solution qui pourrait aider des millions d'entrepreneur demain ? Tu t'épanouis dans un environnement sain, dont les bases sont la confiance et l'autonomie ?

Alors peut-être que Pennylane est fait pour toi !

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs et les cabinets d'expertise comptable à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Pourquoi ce rôle est il si important chez nous ?

Le pôle Grands Comptes de Pennylane a été créé en janvier 2022 pour accompagner les 150 plus grands cabinets comptables français dans leur transformation digitale. Depuis, il s'est imposé comme un levier stratégique de croissance : ce sont des milliers de collaborateurs et de clients finaux embarqués sur Pennylane via des déploiement initiaux ou des rachats de cabinets.

Le Chef de Projet est le pilier de cette relation. Il est le premier visage de Pennylane pour nos partenaires stratégiques, celui qui pose les fondations de la confiance et garantit l'excellence opérationnelle à chaque étape. Avec la croissance du nombre de cabinets à accompagner, nous renforçons notre équipe de 6 Chefs de Projet pour continuer à délivrer un niveau d'accompagnement de haut niveau, mais aussi pour contribuer l’évolution nos pratiques de méthodologies de gestion de projet.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En rejoignant l'équipe Key Account, tu prendras en charge un portefeuille de cabinets comptables Grands Comptes à chaque étape de leur relation avec Pennylane : de la réponse à l'appel d'offres jusqu'au déploiement complet de la solution.

Ton impact se mesure à plusieurs niveaux :

  • Pour les cabinets partenaires : tu es le garant d'une expérience de découverte et de déploiement fluide, professionnelle et rassurante, qui transforme des décisionnaires exigeants en ambassadeurs de Pennylane.

  • Pour Pennylane : tu contribues directement à l’acquisition et au déploiement de nos plus grands partenaires, des comptes à fort enjeu stratégique et commercial.

  • Pour l'équipe : tu contribues à faire évoluer nos process pour les rendre encore plus robustes.

MISSIONS

Pilotage de la phase pilote (3 à 6 mois)

  • Organiser et animer les phases de test sur un échantillon représentatif de collaborateurs et de clients finaux du cabinet.

  • Garantir une couverture exhaustive des fonctionnalités Pennylane, en t'appuyant sur les outils d'analyse et la méthodologie de l'équipe, tout en l'adaptant au contexte de chaque cabinet.

  • KPIs : Maîtrise niveau 1 du produit, de la méthodologie et des outils internes. Prise en charge accompagnée de 1-2 comptes à M+3

Orchestration du déploiement (6 à 9 mois)

  • Construire et piloter le planning de déploiement en co-construction avec les intervenants Pennylane et les équipes projet des cabinets.

  • Coordonner les équipes internes Pennylane mobilisées sur le compte : commercial, migration, interopérabilité, consultant fonctionnel, formateurs, produit.

  • KPIs : Autonomie complète sur la gestion d'un portefeuille de comptes à M+8.

Relation et conseil client

  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence des décisionnaires des cabinets (associés, directeurs transformation, directeurs de production comptable).

  • Comprendre leurs enjeux métier, anticiper leurs besoins et proposer des recommandations proactives pour maximiser l'adoption de la solution.

  • KPIs : maîtrise de l’écosystème comptable, concurrentiel et de la réforme de la facturation électronique à M+3. CSAT > 9/10 à M+6

Conduite du changement & suivi de l'adoption

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie d'embarquement adaptée à chaque cabinet depuis la phase pilote jusqu’au déploiement et proposer des plans d'action correctifs le cas échéant

  • Accompagner les collaborateurs comptables dans la prise en main de Pennylane en analyant les indicateurs d'adoption en phase de déploiement et identifier les risques en amont.

  • KPIs : taux d'adoption des collaborateurs des cabinets conforme aux objectifs fixés avec les cabinets en fin de pilote ou déploiement

Contribution à l'amélioration continue

  • Challenger les process et outils de gestion de projet existants, proposer des améliorations concrètes et les déployer en équipe.

  • KPIs : premier retour structuré sur les process et rapport d’étonnement pertinent à M+3

🎯 Ce que l'on recherche ?

Must have

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet complexe, transformation digitale ou conseil (cabinet ou ESN).

  • Expérience avérée de la gestion de projets multi-interlocuteurs à forte dimension stratégique.

  • Excellente capacité à construire et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des profils décisionnaires exigeants.

  • Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies de gestion de projet (planning, gestion des risques, reporting).

  • Sens aigu du conseil : tu sais amener tes interlocuteurs vers la bonne solution avec diplomatie et conviction.

Nice to have

  • Expérience dans le secteur de l'expertise comptable, de l'audit ou de la Fintech/SaaS B2B.

  • Bases comptables ou compréhension des enjeux de la transformation digitale en cabinet d’expertise comptable.

  • Expérience en conduite du changement.

Ce qui fera la différence

  • Un profil qui sait être à la fois rigoureux sur la méthode et agile dans l'exécution.

  • Une vraie envie de construire, d'améliorer et de laisser une empreinte sur les process de l'équipe.

  • Une posture naturellement orientée conseil et accompagnement, pas uniquement delivery.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Premier échange avec Simon, notre recruteur - 30min

  • Entretien Who avec Aurélie Djoki (Team Lead Project Manager Key Account) - 45min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec Arnaud BERNARD (Head of Key Account) et Aurélie - 1h

  • Entretien final avec Tristan LENOIR (Directeur Partner Success) - 45min

🎁 Ce qu'on peut t'offrir ?

💵 Package : Fixe + Variable

🏥 Une mutuelle très complète (Alan Blue)

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Et enfin, l'opportunité de rejoindre une équipe internationale et dynamique : Nous faisons de nombreux sports ensemble (Foot, footing, escalade... etc), nous adorons passer du temps autour d'un verre, et les deux séminaires d'entreprise annuels (Hossegor, Les deux Alpes, Avignon récemment...) sont des grands moments de cohésion.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
description:
The question

Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards.

What you will do

The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request.

1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network’s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report.

2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured.

3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along.

4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy– accuracy frontier for INL’s PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFET-based analog alternative may be considered where appropriate. Jointly vary sampler steps, stochastic bitstream length and effective precision to identify an operating point predicted to yield a real energy advantage over digital CMOS at a small, tunable loss in sample quality. The result is a frontier predicted from mathematical and hardware models, then verified against calibrated measurements.

A clear negative answer is more useful to us than a vague positive one: a negative result on point 3 leaves points 1 and 2 intact and turns point 4 from a prediction into a measurement.


Who we are looking for Required

• A PhD in applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, electronic engineering, computer science or a closely related field, obtained (or with the defence scheduled) before the start of the contract.

• A strong foundation in probability and stochastic analysis, numerical analysis, optimisation, or machine learning: SDEs, Girsanov’s theorem, time reversal of diffusions, with the ability to apply it rigorously to diffusion or other generative models.

• Familiarity with the convergence theory of sampling algorithms, or the demonstrated capacity to acquire it quickly, for example through Langevin/MCMC analysis, optimal transport or concentration of measure.

• Solid scientific computing (PyTorch or JAX), and the habit of writing code others can run. Ability and motivation to work across mathematical modelling and hardware-aware AI.

• Working English; French is not required.

Valued, not required

Prior work on diffusion or score-based generative models; numerical analysis of finite-precision arithmetic. Familiarity with hardware-aware machine learning, approximate or stochastic computing, analogue in-memory computing, device modelling, circuit simulation, photonics, ferroelectric devices, or energy modelling. Experience linking model accuracy or robustness to implementation non-idealities, such as quantisation, noise, drift, variability, finite precision, or correlated errors. Evidence of interdisciplinary research, for example work at the interface of mathematics, machine learning, devices, circuits, architectures, or electronic-design automation. No hardware experience is expected or needed to apply.

What matters most

We are seeking a researcher who wants to explore how to turn physical constraints into mathematical and architectural design parameters. The project does not require prior laboratory hardware experience: INL provides device expertise, measured characteristics and modelling infrastructure. However, the successful candidate must be prepared to engage critically with non-ideal analog, photonic and ferroelectric accelerators, and to work with both supervisors to connect device-level error mechanisms, score-error guarantees and the energy–quality trade-off of diffusion-model inference. Candidates with a primarily mathematical background and strong curiosity for hardware are welcome, as are candidates from AIhardware, device-modeling, circuit, architecture or EDA backgrounds who have the stochastic-analysis maturity needed to develop the theory. The decisive criterion is the ability to make the mathematics and hardware inform one another, producing predictions that are quantitative, testable and relevant to an energy-efficient accelerator demonstrator.

What we offer

• A real double supervision, with weekly meetings that alternate between ICJ and INL. The two laboratories are on the same campus, five minutes apart on foot.

• A question publishable on both sides: mathematics journals for the theory, design and hardware venues for the co-design.

• Involvement in INL’s design–technology co-optimisation work through the PEPR Électronique CHOOSE project, and contact with the group’s ferroelectric and photonic device work (FVLLMONTI, Ferro4EdgeAI).

• Support for conference travel and open-access publication, funded by the two host laboratories, and the career-development measures the establishment provides for post-doctoral researchers.

• Practical help for international recruits through Espace ULYS, the EURAXESS service centre for Université de Lyon: visas, housing, health cover, banking, schooling.

Conditions

Twelve-month fixed-term contract under French public law, full time (1 607 h annual reference), 25 working days of annual leave plus the RTT days of the establishment’s scheme. Affiliation to the régime général for health and to IRCANTEC for supplementary pension; employer contribution to complementary health cover under the scheme in force at the establishment; 75 % reimbursement of publictransport season tickets, up to the statutory ceiling. The exact number of RTT days is set by the establishment.

Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries successfully complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centres, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

Sterling is a fast-growing B2B SaaS technology business.  We have recently been acquired by TransPerfect, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in over 120 cities on six continents.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority

  • Based out of Paris, with travel required within France as needed

Sounds like a match? We look forward to meeting you!

By applying, I confirm I have read and accept TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting


Essential skills and experience:

  •  Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent

  •  Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

  •  Proven track record in sales or a client-facing role

  •  Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

  •  Strong presentation skills (both in-person and online)

  •  Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French

  •  Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

  •  Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  •  Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

Preferred experience:

  • Experience and/or interest in Financial, Professional, Legal or Technology services 

  • Experience in a B2B sales/business development role

TransPerfect AI offers a premier product suite that addresses the most critical bottlenecks in the AI lifecycle, from LLM fine-tuning to high-stakes data security. We are in a hyper-growth phase. title: Director, Business Development
description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

  • English — fluent, business-level (essential)

  • Additional languages a plus

 

Education

  • Degree in **Business, Marketing, Communications, Languages, or a creative discipline** — or equivalent professional experience

title: Responsable Systèmes d'Information & Outils internes H/F
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers.

Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions s’imposent aujourd’hui comme des références sur le   marché :

N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

  • des outils qui ne communiquent pas toujours efficacement entre eux

  • des données encore partiellement silotées

  • certains processus insuffisamment maîtrisés

  • un potentiel d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA encore peu exploité

Certaines briques sont déjà portées en interne, mais de manière partielle ou trop manuelle.

Nous créons ce poste pour structurer durablement le SI, fiabiliser les flux et accompagner la montée en maturité de l’organisation.

Ton rôle

Rattaché au CTO, tu interviens de manière transverse sur l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

Le poste est volontairement hybride : à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. L’objectif n’est pas uniquement de piloter, mais de comprendre, structurer et mettre en œuvre.

Tu travailles en lien étroit avec le CODIR et les équipes métiers.

Tes responsabilités

Structuration du SI et des flux

  • Cartographier les outils et les flux existants

  • Identifier les points de friction et les incohérences

  • Structurer la circulation de la donnée (clients, prospects, finance…)

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les intégrations entre les systèmes

L’objectif est d’éliminer les silos et de fiabiliser les échanges de données.

Reprise en main des sujets critiques

  • Monter en compétence sur les outils clés, notamment la facturation

  • Fiabiliser les processus existants

  • Réduire la dépendance aux tâches manuelles via l’automatisation

Pilotage de l’écosystème outils

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers

  • Définir une logique cohérente d’évolution du SI

  • Arbitrer entre amélioration de l’existant et mise en place de nouveaux outils

  • Piloter les projets SI de bout en bout

Management d’équipe

  • Encadrer une équipe de 3 développeurs

  • Prioriser les sujets en fonction des enjeux business

  • Structurer le backlog et assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise

Développement des usages IA

  • Identifier des cas d’usage concrets avec les équipes

  • Prototyper et déployer des solutions

  • Accompagner l’adoption


Ce que tu apportes

  • 6 à 10 ans d’expérience en SI applicatif, Business Systems ou équivalent

  • Une expérience en environnement SaaS (idéalement dans des structures de 200 à 500 personnes)

  • Une bonne maîtrise des problématiques d’intégration et de flux de données (API, webhooks, synchronisation)

  • Une capacité à comprendre, challenger et structurer un écosystème d’outils dans sa globalité

  • Une expérience avec des outils d’automatisation (Make, Zapier, n8n ou équivalent)

  • Une expérience en management d’équipe technique

  • Une capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés

Ce poste n’est pas adapté si

  • tu es très orienté(e) grands groupes avec des SI lourds et peu agiles

  • tu recherches un rôle purement stratégique sans implication opérationnelle

  • ton expertise est principalement orientée sécurité (ce périmètre est couvert par un autre rôle)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Une entreprise SaaS solide avec des fondamentaux rares, qui combine croissance soutenue et rentabilité

  • Tu arrives à un moment clé où beaucoup reste à structurer pour passer un cap, avec déjà une base existante

  • Une proximité avec la direction, un bon niveau d’autonomie et des cycles de décision rapides

  • Un rôle avec un impact visible rapidement, aussi bien sur les équipes que sur les résultats

  • Des sujets variés et concrets, entre structuration du SI et montée en gamme

  • Une équipe accessible, impliquée et orientée résultats

Poste basé à Montagnat (01) avec présence attendue 2 jours par semaine.
